description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into GitHub Issues in a target repo. Rows are matched to existing issues by a stable key marker embedded in the issue body, not by title (so a human editing the title doesn't break the sync).

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one GitHub issue (upserted via key_column).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated / rows_closed). No downstream data -- write side effect lands in GitHub.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

key_column.label: Key Column
key_column.description: Upstream column holding a stable unique key. Written into each issue's body as a marker and used to match rows to existing issues on subsequent runs.

body_column.label: Body Column
body_column.description: Column holding the issue body (markdown). Leave empty for title-only issues.

labels_column.label: Labels Column
labels_column.description: Column holding labels. Accepts a list, or a comma-separated string.

state_column.label: State Column
state_column.description: Column holding state ('open' or 'closed'). Defaults to 'open' if unset.

assignees_column.label: Assignees Column
assignees_column.description: Column holding assignee logins. Accepts a list, or a comma-separated string.

default_labels.label: Default Labels
default_labels.description: Labels always applied to every synced issue, on top of labels_column.

close_missing.label: Close Missing
close_missing.description: If true, close open issues whose key marker is NOT in the upstream DataFrame.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows to process per run (safety cap).

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily' / 'weekly' / 'monthly' / 'hourly' / 'static' / 'multi' / 'dynamic' / None. A partitioned run sends only the rows in its partition (see partition_date_column / partition_static_column).

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning.

partition_date_column.description: Column used to filter the rows to send to the current date partition key.
partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column

partition_static_column.description: Column used to filter the rows to send to the current static partition value.
partition_static_column.label: Partition Static Column

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

name: GitHub Issue Upsert
